startingActionId.description: Id of the action that executes {@link startWorkflow}

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

workflowRef.description: Reference to the parent {@link Workflow} being executed by this run.

spec.description: Holds a copy of the spec that was passed to {@link Workflow#start}.

workflowId.description: Id of workflow.  Used for fkey array in `Workflow`.

sourceValuesInitialized.description: Used by internal implementation for preparing source vertices for execution.

currentVertexRuns.description: Map, keyed by vertex id, of currently running vertices for the workflow.  There can be more than one.

finallyVertexWorkflowRun.description:
The run of the workflow which executes the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} of the workflow.
This run could be used to make sure the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} is done executing.
The {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} execution starts after the {@link Workflow.Run} transitions into completed, failed, or canceled state.
The output of the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} could be retrieved using {@link Workflow.Run#executionResults} keyed
by `finallyVertexOutput`.

runStatus.description: Status for the overall workflow run.

results.description:
Accumulated results returned from each vertex's result function upon completion, keyed by the "out" port id.  These
values may be used by subsequent vertices.

startedBy.description:
Id of the user that started the workflow.  This will be set automatically by the system to the current user during
the creation of the run and cannot be changed.  Any value set manually in the create request will be ignored.

updating.description:
If true, then {@link Workflow.Run#updateStatus} is currently being called by something in the system.
This is used as a lock to ensure safe concurrent updates to this run.

canceling.description:
If true, then {@link Workflow.Run#updateStatus} cancels all running vertices,
and sets the status to 'canceled'.

updatingStartTime.description: The time at which the {@link #updating} lock was acquired. Used to timeout the lock.

parentWorkflowRun.description:
Optional parent {@link WorkflowExecutorRun} that launches this instance of {@link Workflow}.
This is used for invalidating the corresponding parent {@link WorkflowQueue} entry as part of
finally vertex execution of this {@link Workflow}.
See {@link Workflow.Vertex#requiresPolling} for additional details.

title: A specific run for a workflow.  It holds all status information about the run.
name: Workflow.Run
